name: List environments
description: List environments List a particular project's environments matching the provided filters. GET /v1/environments
context:
GET /v1/environments
List a particular project's environments matching the provided filters. If no filters are provided, all environments are returned.
Required: projectId (query) — Filter for resources that belong to a project
Optional: name (query) — Filter by name; createdBefore (query) — Filter for resources created before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); createdAfter (query) — Filter for resources created after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedBefore (query) — Filter for resources updated before a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); updatedAfter (query) — Filter for resources updated after a certain time (specified as an ISO 8601 timestamp); ownerId (query) — The ID of the workspaces to return resources for; environmentId (query) — Filter for resources that belong to an environment; cursor (query) — The position in the result list to start from when fetching paginated results. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).; limit (query) — The maximum number of items to return. For details, see [Pagination](https://api-docs.render.com/reference/pagination).
